title: The Impact of Management on Clinical Performance: Evidence from Physician Practice Management Companies
eligible_reason: Staggered acquisition design (physician practices acquired by three PPMCs at physician-specific years), but no reported specification satisfies the rules: every main regression includes patient-level time-varying controls (insurance, race, comorbidity indicators) and/or three separate PPMC treatment indicators plus transition-year dummies as additional treatment regressors. The main analytic data (Florida AHCA inpatient discharges, SK&A practice data) are not in the package.
design_notes: Inferred from _code/6_variables_provider_practice.do and 7_analysis.do (no article text). Unit: physician (licnum); time: year (2006-2014); observations are births (patient-level) in Florida. Treatment: physician's practice joins PPMC k (k=1,2,3) in year ppmc{k}_year_joined; ppmc{k}_join_ind = 1 from join year on; main_ppmc{k} = switch_ppmc{k} (join indicator x 'main switcher' flag) set to 0 in the join year, with the join year absorbed by transition{k} dummies; main_ppmc = any of the three. Event-time dummies ppmc{k}_tminus{t}/tplus{t} = treated*(tsjyr==t) within PPMC group k, t-1 omitted. FE in main columns: licnum + year#ppmc (PPMC group x year; ppmc=0 for never-acquired), alternatives year#ahcaid (hospital), year#pt_zip, year. Cluster ska_group (SK&A practice organization). Regression sample low_reg = treated==1 & lowrisk==1 where treated = ppmc{k}_main_switch==1 (main switchers, defined in redacted cleaning code; whether never-acquired physicians enter the regression sample cannot be verified). Controls local: private medicaid medicaid_managed selfpay black latinx white com* (patient-level, time-varying). Table 4 uses continuous patient-exposure shares (ppmc{k}_share*_main). Join years span roughly 2007-2014 (Figure 3 share series), so multiple cohorts, exact count unknown.
estimators_reported: TWFE static with three PPMC treatment indicators + transition dummies (reghdfe)
